decisions.reason: The formwork profile system has its own page, which signals a substantial investment and a visible commitment to the firm's precast formwork direction, so one year of results gives management no reason to drop it.

The automated distributor control is only mentioned on the website, so its visibility is lower, but it represents real development investment and early results can still be put down to slow market adoption.
The shuttering magnet block is core to the firm's magnetic formwork line, and management would justify keeping it as part of that announced direction despite its minor web presence.
The magnetic formwork strips are presented prominently and sit at the centre of the firm's product strategy, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping them.
This magnetic formwork component has its own page and fits the firm's core magnetic system, so the visible commitment supports keeping it.
This component is less visible and only mentioned, which makes it the easiest candidate for a quiet drop, but it belongs to the committed magnetic range, so the firm keeps it for now.
